column2: Akira-kun, I'm coming too.
Wait! I'm coming too.
Ryo...
Let's ask Dr. Saotome about the situation. We'll make a plan after that. Dr. Saotome should be in the room at the back of this floor...
That's interesting... Thank you for the report.
Then I'll be going!
Heh heh...
You came at just the right time. New information has come in. Take a look at the news.
People who were controlled by black things and claim to have heard the Demon King's voice are beginning to gather in one place!
It's the Hill of Beginnings!
These people have begun building an altar on this hill! They're even making an eerie statue!
An altar and a statue?
People who worship the Demon King are gathering one after another!
They say the people are saying the same words you heard, {p}-kun.
The words I heard?
The time of joining...
Greater power...
Ambition realized...
This can only mean one thing!
The Demon King hasn't gained his full power yet...!
I don't know what the time of joining means. But when it comes, the Demon King will unleash his true power!
Before that happens, we've gotta do something...!
We'd like to build up our forces somehow too. A report has come in from the Getter Team. It seems the Mechasaurus that should have been wiped out has come back to life.
We should assume the Demon King is spreading his power at an astonishing rate. We must all stand united against this crisis!
But Doctor...\n\nAs long as people are being controlled by the black fiends, weapons developed to protect humans could be used to wipe out mankind...
...I can't say it won't happen.\n\nWe can no longer tell who's friend and who's foe.
No way!
But maybe it's a chance to make friends with people who used to be enemies!
If it goes well, anyway.
Saotome here. ...I see. Understood.
They've driven the rioters out of the area around the residential area. I have a meeting now, so I'll excuse myself.

The Demon King calls you the "Sun of rebirth"\n\nand {s} the "Moon of destruction." And the rioters are saying to hand {p}-kun over to the Demon King. I believe this is connected to what the Demon King calls the "time of joining."
Don't leave the residential area. If the Demon King captures you, this "time of joining" may come...
They're after you! Don't leave the residential area!
Excuse me! Rioters broke through a window and got in! Please give me a hand!
What!?
So where are these rioters?
That's odd, I'm sure they were around here...?
You're safe, {p}!\n\nIt's dangerous alone. I'm coming too!
So you're both back... The meeting just ended. Dr. Saotome wants to see you!
{p}-kun! I've finally found the answer! The Demon King is waiting for a solar eclipse!
You mean an eclipse, when the moon blocks the sun's light?
That's right!\n\nMost likely, the Demon King will gain his true power when the eclipse comes.
Every time the Dimension Chain has occurred, a certain thing has appeared. The black moon!\n\nSo when an eclipse happens, what appears?
Huh...? Uh, um... Oh!
That's right, a black sun!\n\nWhen the black sun appears, the Demon King will gain his true power!
So when's the next eclipse?
Tomorrow...
Tomorrow!?
We must make a plan at once! Come to the salon! It's a strategy meeting!
...So there you have it, everyone! The eclipse is upon us tomorrow! If my reasoning is correct, that's when the Demon King gains his true power!
{p}-kun! There's something I forgot to tell you. In all likelihood, {s} is alive and well!
The proof is that you're alive.\n\nAfter all, the Demon King called {s} the "moon" and you the "sun"!
I see... If the Demon King needs me... then there's a good chance {s} is still alive too!
The Demon King is keeping watch over {s} so she can't escape. And he's probably controlling people to try to get his hands on you.
I'm going to the Hill of Beginnings to rescue {s}!
You mustn't!
Why not!?
'Cause the Demon King wants to get his hands on you. Before the eclipse, too!
We expect the rioters to launch an all-out attack to capture you, {p}-kun!
We can't let you fall into the Demon King's hands! Stay here!
But...
I'd love to join the assault team, but I'm gonna stay here to protect you.
Thanks, Akira-kun!
It seems the roles are settled.\n\nShinichi-kun, join the assault team headed for the Hill of Beginnings! Shusha-kun, stay here and lead the defense team! And Akira-kun, never leave {p}'s side!
Leave it to me. I'll snatch {s} back!
Nobody's getting near {p}!
If worst comes to worst, leave it to me!
Don't worry, the worst won't come! Combine all your strength and you can defeat anyone!
Dr. Saotome! Something big is happening at the Hill of Beginnings! The rioters keep pouring in, and it's turned into a castle!
We took pictures after fighting the giant black fiends. Everybody, take a look.
The Hill of Beginnings seems to mean something special to the Demon King. Before we knew it, there were this many black fiends...
What numbers... How big are they?
Every last one of 'em is huge. They'd give Getter a run for its money.
Hmmm...
And the Hill of Beginnings...
The TV news said it was an altar before...!
That's how much the Demon King's power has grown.
A fearsome foe, this Demon King...!!
If the black fiends are as big as Getter or the Mechasaurus, then Ryo! You're the vanguard! Draw the black fiends' attention and protect the assault team!
Roger that!
That's a splendid idea, Enma-kun! Great King Enma! I ask this of you as well!
Good! That concludes our strategy meeting! Everyone! Good luck!
Good! Will you go, Shinichi-kun?
Dr. Saotome, the vanguard's all set! The Getter Team is heading for the Hill of Beginnings!
Good! I'm counting on you, Ryo!
Good luck, Ryo-san!
Leave it to me!
Trust us, {p}!
We're off!
The defense team will wait here.\n\nDoctor, you all stay somewhere safe in the back.
Good. I'm counting on you.
I'm counting on you, Shusha!
Get some rest, {p}. As long as we're here, you won't be needed!
Thanks, Shusha-kun!
{p}, let's go back to the back room together. We'll wait for reports there.
